name: Middlesex University
description:
Middlesex University is a university based in Hendon, in north west London, getting its name because it lies within the historic country boundaries of Middlesex. It dates back to 1878 and a womenâ€™s teacher training college. Several mergers later, it became a university in 1992 and now has campuses in Dubai, Mauritius and Malta.

Globally it has more than 37,000 students, with 19,000 studying in London, including international students from more than 167 different countries. It also has student exchange links with over 100 international universities. Middlesex University has been named the second best university in the UK by Young Universities and third best for international outlook. Itâ€™s also in the top 7 for entrepreneurs and business leaders in the UK according to Hitachi Capital Finance.

What is the Middlesex University acceptance rate?

The Middlesex University acceptance rate is 57%.

Student Life

Middlesex Student Union has previously won Student Union of the Year awards because of the lengths they go to in order to provide a satisfactory student experience. Live music, comedy, film screenings, quiz nights, and graduation balls are all arranged by the Student Union throughout the year. More than 85 student clubs are set up by students for fellow students, including sports, cultural and special interest societies. Students can also choose to apply for roles such as Student Ambassador, or work as IT support, as a translator, a fashion model, a musician or a sports assistant.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Looking for a top-ranked public research university with a global presence? Middlesex University is your ideal choice. The university is ranked among the best in the UK and offers you a diverse range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across various disciplines. These include Business, Law, Health & Education, Engineering & Technology, Media & Creative Arts, Data Science, Cyber Security, Nursing, and Banking & Finance, to name a few.

Globally it has more than 37,000 students, with 19,000 studying in London, including international students from more than 167 different countries. It also has student exchange links with over 100 international universities. Middlesex University has been named the second best university in the UK by Young Universities and third best for international outlook. It's also in the top 7 for entrepreneurs and business leaders in the UK according to Hitachi Capital Finance.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
At the university, you’ll have many opportunities to meet new people. With 85+ student societies and MDXWorks and Unitemps offering career support, it’s easy to find a community and gain work experience while you study. 

Plus, their Students’ Union provides a range of services, from mental health support to financial advice, ensuring you feel supported throughout your university journey. You can also choose to apply for roles such as Student Ambassador, or work as IT support, as a translator, a fashion model, a musician or a sports assistant.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Middlesex University offers you a variety of modern, high-quality accommodation options. You can choose from several halls of residence, with your own bedroom and shared facilities. The university can also help you get homestay living options, where a host family provides you with housing arrangements.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At Middlesex University, you’ll find the Sheppard Library with 24/7 study zones, the Financial Markets Suite, and the Law Wing. This facility offers you extensive resources for your studies, including thousands of books, journals, and digital materials.

Sports
The university has several modern sports facilities such as a gym, football pitches, outdoor courts, a bouldering wall, and a sports science centre at Allianz Park.

Laboratory
The university provides you with cutting-edge equipment for teaching and research. You’ll find medical and nursing simulation labs, the UK’s first “Cyber Factory”, and design engineering studios.

Cafeteria
You’ll find multiple cafes and eateries on campus, along with many study zones.
